text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Not yet.
This isn't enough to reach Suzuka...!

Lately, there has been a certain precariousness
sensing in Air Groove during training...

"Her focus on ‘Defeating Silence Suzuka’
might be making her a bit too eager."
choice_data_list: (I wish she could get a little break…)
(I wish there was some way she could unwind…)

text_block_list.text: When I thought about that, I suddenly realized that I still hadn't gone for my New Year's shrine visit yet.

It's Air Groove, who pointed out my lack of seasonal awareness last year.
If I tell her I haven't done Hatsumode yet,
she might come along with me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
“—What are you staring at me for?
Was there something about my running that caught your eye?”
choice_data_list: Actually, I still haven't gone for my New Year's shrine visit...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
“—Wh-What a dreadful oversight.
For someone like me to—”
Air Groove is way more flustered than I could have ever imagined...!
Surprised that the situation was that grave in her mind, I—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: To think I forgot to go on our Hatsumode visit...!!
choice_data_list: Wait, Air Groove too?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The blunder of a lifetime...! To get so focused on training that I completely forgot an annual tradition...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: There's no time to waste! You, get ready immediately! We're going to the shrine!

I hadn't expected Air Groove to forget as well,
but it seemed like a good chance to catch our breath, so I decided to get ready for Hatsumode.
After finishing our prayers at a nearby shrine together, Air Groove and I—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "...Just this once, you have my thanks. If you hadn't mentioned it, it would have completely slipped my mind."
choice_data_list: You're welcome.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, what came over me?
This is definitive proof that I've grown lax...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I need to tighten my focus even more...
Otherwise, against Suzuka—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Alright. Let's head back and resume training.
Time is precious right now.

"At this rate, she's going to push herself too hard again...
Wondering how I could get her to rest today,
after thinking through various ideas, what came to mind was—"
choice_data_list: Want to eat something fitting for New Year's?
Want to eat something fitting for New Year's?
Let's write 'I want to become stronger' on an ema!
Let's draw a fortune slip!

text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, she's going to push herself too hard again...
Wondering how I could get her to rest today,
after thinking through various ideas, what came to mind was—"
choice_data_list: Want to eat something fitting for New Year's?
Want to eat something fitting for New Year's?
Let's write 'I want to become stronger' on an ema!
Let's draw a fortune slip!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, you, were you even listening to me?
I don't have the time to—
choice_data_list: Not doing anything New Year's-ish this year?
Aren't you going to do anything New Year's-y this year?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Guh—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, between this New Year's visit and everything else, I can hardly say
I've experienced a proper New Year this year...
choice_data_list: It's all about the seasonal feel, the seasonal feel.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Look at you, talking like that now...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, understood.
It's true that at this rate, there's no clear rhythm to it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Let's grab something New Year-ish to eat on the way back.
Well? Do you have any ideas, you?"
choice_data_list: ...Like ozoni?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Is ozoni the only New Year's food you know of?
Afterward, Air Groove and I ate ozoni and returned to the academy.

It seemed the tension had eased up a bit,
making for a nice, refreshing break...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
“'I want to become strong' is a rather crude way to put it.
Besides, I hardly have the time for that right now—”
choice_data_list: Don't you usually write an ema?
Don't you usually write an ema?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I usually write one.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Making a wish and writing it down heightens one's sense of purpose, after all.
choice_data_list: Then let's write it!
Then let's write it down!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah.
That's what I should have done right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I take back what I said earlier.
It seems... I am somewhat impatient today.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Alright.
Let's write on the ema.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And so—
What do you intend to write?
choice_data_list: May Air Groove become the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Fool. Think about your phrasing a little more.
Afterward, Air Groove and I debated back and forth on what to write on our ema.

During our conversation, the tension in her seemed
to ease a bit, which brought a wave of relief.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Were you even listening to me?
I told you we don't have time to waste—
choice_data_list: Doesn't it feel like it's not really New Year's if you don't draw a fortune?
Doesn't it feel like it's not really New Year's if you don't draw a fortune?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ……I can kind of see your point.
choice_data_list: I can't even finish our New Year's shrine visit.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...
You've certainly gotten bold with your words.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll take you up on that for today. Now that it's settled, let's go pull right away!
Afterward, the fortune Air Groove drew contained the message: "Don't push yourself too hard. Be flexible"—

Taking this to heart, Air Groove stopped frantically rushing
her training and reconsidered what workouts were truly necessary right now.

"In the end, that prevented her from overworking
and led to far more efficient training."
